# Lexical Sources

This directory contains compiled research summaries derived from the official
Lexical monorepo at `/Users/zbeyens/git/lexical` plus the live docs entrypoints
on `https://lexical.dev`.

Decisions:

- [Anchors, annotations and inline paint ownership](../../decisions/2026-09-20-annotations-ownership.md). Plite anchors, annotation store and decoration paint decisions, with a final external validation that summarizes ProseMirror, CodeMirror, Monaco, Lexical, Automerge, Tiptap and Yjs annotation facts.
- [Autocomplete query and activation ownership](../../decisions/autocomplete-ownership.md). Plate ordinary-text autocomplete owner and Plite settleInput, citing Lexical and Tiptap as ordinary-text precedent and a twelve-editor survey (only Atlassian isolates the query).
- [Editor node DX should use runtime owned shells and spec first renderers](../../decisions/editor-node-dx-should-use-runtime-owned-shells-and-spec-first-renderers.md). Plate/Plite node-authoring decision that weighs what ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap each prove, and states what crosses the Yjs sync boundary. Second reader removed yjs-collaboration.
- [Document import and conversion fidelity](../../decisions/import-fidelity.md). Plate/Plite format parse, diagnostics and admission contract, with a validation benchmark comparing ProseMirror, CKEditor, Slate, Lexical and Tiptap.
- [Plugin input rules guide should lead with runtime first then feature owners then API reference](../../decisions/plugin-input-rules-guide-should-lead-with-runtime-first-then-feature-owners-then-api-reference.md). Plate docs-structure decision that compares the Tiptap, Slate, Lexical and ProseMirror documentation patterns.
- [Slate v2 collaborative annotations use external channels by default](../../decisions/slate-v2-collaborative-annotation-channels.md). Plite decision that comments live in external annotation channels, drawing on ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap, with Yjs relative-position anchors. Second reader removed yjs-collaboration.
- [Slate v2 should pursue data-model-first core with React-perfect runtime lanes](../../decisions/slate-v2-data-model-first-react-perfect-runtime.md). Slate v2 runtime-lane decision built from legacy Slate's model/chunking and field evidence from ProseMirror, Lexical, VS Code, Pretext, TanStack DB and EditContext. Second reader removed slate.
- [Slate v2 Node Query API Should Keep Lazy Entries, Early-Exit Helpers, And Explicit Materialization](../../decisions/slate-v2-node-query-api-should-keep-lazy-entries-and-add-first-match-helpers.md). Slate v2 node-query API decision with a reference table comparing legacy Slate, ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap traversal APIs.
- [Slate v2 overlay architecture cuts](../../decisions/slate-v2-overlay-architecture-cuts.md). The April 2026 Slate v2 overlay cuts (decoration, annotation and widget lanes, Bookmark as the anchor noun, RangeRef demoted), justified by what ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap each prove; current Plite has neither Bookmark nor RangeRef and keeps durable positions through its anchor API (packages/plitejs/src/core/anchor.ts).
- [Slate v2 overlay architecture beats legacy Slate and aligns with the best parts of the field](../../decisions/slate-v2-overlay-superiority-vs-legacy-and-field.md). Judges the April 2026 Slate v2 overlay design against legacy Slate and against ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap, one section each.
- [Slate v2 perfect plan should steal read update transaction discipline and extension DX](../../decisions/slate-v2-perfect-plan-should-steal-read-update-transaction-discipline-and-extension-dx.md). Plite steal/reject/defer decision across Lexical, ProseMirror and Tiptap.
- [Slate v2 post-closure architecture review](../../decisions/slate-v2-post-closure-architecture-review.md). Plite post-closure review: no pivot to Lexical, ProseMirror or Tiptap, and a typing-lane comparison against legacy Slate chunking.
- [React 19.2 makes Slate v2 a first-class React-native perf architecture, not a universal engine winner](../../decisions/slate-v2-react-19-2-perf-architecture-vs-field.md). Plite perf-architecture claim compared with legacy Slate, ProseMirror and Lexical (and VS Code, which has no home). Second reader removed slate.
- [Slate v2 should use read/update as the public runtime lifecycle](../../decisions/slate-v2-read-update-runtime-architecture.md). Plite read/update lifecycle decision, derived from a cross-editor comparison of Lexical, ProseMirror and Tiptap.
- [Slate v2 should add source-scoped overlay invalidation before claiming field-best decoration perf architecture](../../decisions/slate-v2-source-scoped-overlay-invalidation.md). April 2026 Slate v2 source-scoped invalidation decision, motivated by ProseMirror and Lexical invalidation compared with a projection store Plite no longer has.
- [Slate v2 should use state and tx callback APIs with extension namespaces](../../decisions/slate-v2-state-tx-public-api-and-extension-namespaces.md). Slate v2 state/tx API and extension-namespace decision, argued from Lexical read/update, ProseMirror transactions and Tiptap command DX.

Research runs:

- [2026-06-12-browser-longtask-selection-oracles](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-browser-longtask-selection-oracles). Combines Long Tasks API claim width with Lexical and ProseMirror selectionchange, drag and native-selection oracle source reads, then promotes Plite benchmark and screenshot helpers.
- [2026-06-12-huge-doc-native-selection](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-huge-doc-native-selection). Plite huge-document vertical selection and its benchmark packets, compared with ProseMirror's native-first geometry, Lexical's model select-all and dirty selection, legacy Slate's chunking example, and Tiptap as a ProseMirror duplicate.
- [2026-06-12-ime-overlap-policy](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-ime-overlap-policy). Plite IME overlap-cancellation policy built from ProseMirror overlap tests, Lexical composition-key ownership and VS Code composition lifecycle.
- [2026-06-12-oss-clipboard-paste-architecture](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-oss-clipboard-paste-architecture). Plite clipboard and paste proof promoted from ProseMirror's composition guard and slice metadata, CodeMirror's DOM flush and Lexical's DataTransfer priority.
- [2026-06-12-oss-history-undo-architecture](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-oss-history-undo-architecture). Compares prosemirror-history skipped-edit remapping, Lexical merge/composition policy and legacy Slate adjacent merge, then adds a Plite history contract row.
- [2026-06-12-table-fragment-semantics](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-table-fragment-semantics). Maps prosemirror-tables rectangle copy/paste algebra, Tiptap's re-export of it and Lexical's table selection/clipboard contrast onto Plite's skipped insertFragment/of-tables fixtures.
- [2026-06-13-beforeinput-target-range-selection-policy](../../../plite/research/2026-06-13-beforeinput-target-range-selection-policy). Lexical and CodeMirror beforeinput target-range handling validates Plite's P155 selection-import policy (ProseMirror and Tiptap are only no-hit scans).
- [2026-06-13-editor-property-fuzzing-oracles](../../../plite/research/2026-06-13-editor-property-fuzzing-oracles). Compares ProseMirror and CodeMirror DOM-change webtests with Lexical's test recorder and regressions, and promotes a Plite generated DOM-mutation import stress family.
- [2026-06-13-ime-composition-policy-scout](../../../plite/research/2026-06-13-ime-composition-policy-scout). CodeMirror, ProseMirror and Lexical composition-lifecycle source plus W3C specs bound Plite's IME overlap policy claim.
- [2026-06-13-native-text-repair-idle-oss-validation](../../../plite/research/2026-06-13-native-text-repair-idle-oss-validation). ProseMirror DOM-observer timing and Lexical input/microtask scheduling validate Plite's 1ms native text repair idle.
- [2026-06-13-oss-rich-html-paste-clipboard-invariants](../../../plite/research/2026-06-13-oss-rich-html-paste-clipboard-invariants). Compares Lexical paste regressions, ProseMirror clipboard/table slices and Tiptap transformPastedHTML/link paste against Plite paste proof.
- [2026-06-13-oss-selection-ime-paste-oracle-scout](../../../plite/research/2026-06-13-oss-selection-ime-paste-oracle-scout). Cross-editor scout of ProseMirror paste/selectionchange, CodeMirror composition, Lexical DataTransfer tests, Tiptap's ProseMirror delegation and Monaco smoke, routed to Plite proof.
- [2026-06-13-playwright-editor-e2e-timing-oracles](../../../plite/research/2026-06-13-playwright-editor-e2e-timing-oracles). Lexical issue #7739 and playground clipboard helpers checked against Plite's existing plite-browser clipboard and selection wait helpers.
- [2026-06-14-firefox-inline-selection-mouseup](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-firefox-inline-selection-mouseup). ProseMirror pointer-selection sync, Lexical selection restore, an upstream Slate skipped inline row and WPT fixtures are compared against Plite's Firefox inline-link repair.
- [2026-06-14-generated-stress-replay-reduction](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-generated-stress-replay-reduction). Plite generated-stress reduction artifacts, checked against Lexical's test recorder, CodeMirror random view tests and WPT fixture tables.
- [2026-06-14-inline-void-decoration-oracles](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-inline-void-decoration-oracles). ProseMirror composition/decoration/inline-atom/clipboard webtests and Lexical composition and mention-entity source, mapped to a Plite decoration-boundary projection contract.
- [2026-06-14-selection-input-oracles](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-selection-input-oracles). ProseMirror composition webtests and Lexical beforeinput/target-range/paste source mapped to existing Plite richtext IME and selection-reconciler coverage.
- [2026-06-14-selection-paste-undo-oracles](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-selection-paste-undo-oracles). Plite paste, undo and selection oracles sampled from ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap tests (Monaco rejected).
- [2026-06-14-selection-triple-click-inline-normalization](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-selection-triple-click-inline-normalization). Plite triple-click and inline selection proof repair, based on Lexical selection-normalization source and classic Slate's Editor.unhangRange docs.
- [2026-06-14-yjs-large-doc-import-readback](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-yjs-large-doc-import-readback). Plite's Yjs binding large-doc remote import, benchmark split and Yjs event/delta substrate, with one-line prior-art claims about the @lexical/yjs binding (event-driven sync) and y-prosemirror (transaction-driven sync).
- [2026-08-17-document-schema-migrations](../../../plite/research/2026-08-17-document-schema-migrations). Plate document version-chain migration design compared across Dexie, Redux Persist, Zustand and Sanity, with Lexical per-node versions, ProseMirror fromJSON and Tiptap's math utility as editor negatives.
- [2026-08-17-editor-node-model-standards](../../../plite/research/2026-08-17-editor-node-model-standards). Plate's persisted node model (headings, code, lists, media, tables, identity) compared field by field with MDAST/UNIST, ProseMirror, Lexical, Slate (source plus 14 issue/PR threads), BlockNote, Portable Text, Editor.js and Quill.
- [2026-09-10-authored-changes](../../../plite/research/2026-09-10-authored-changes). An assessment of Plate Suggestion/Comments and Plite DocumentChange/state/Yjs ownership for authored revisions that compares Yjs 14, y-prosemirror and Y/hub; ProseMirror track-changes plugins (prosemirror-changeset, prosemirror-suggest-changes, Manuscripts); Tiptap's tracked-changes docs; Lexical history; and Automerge, Loro, SuperDoc, Quill and Google Docs.
- [2026-09-11-large-documents-contract](../../../plite/research/2026-09-11-large-documents-contract). Plite large-document rendering, pagination, coverage and packaging contract, with pinned source reads of ProseMirror viewdesc (composing-node identity), Lexical's reconciler, the Slate chunking walkthrough, and CodeMirror and TanStack as cross-editor evidence.
- [2026-09-17-table-substrate-ownership](../../../plite/research/2026-09-17-table-substrate-ownership). It decides how Plate's table feature, its copied UI and Plite's selection and host-lifetime owners split selection, resize and paint (plite, including a Happy DOM probe of the real paint hook), by comparing table selection and resize ownership across editors (editor-architecture), with source-level facts about prosemirror-tables and prosemirror-state (prosemirror), Tiptap's extension-table (tiptap), @lexical/table and its playground resizer (lexical), ProseKit's table-handle and resizable components (prosekit), and Milkdown's preset-gfm table commands and view (milkdown). Second reader added yjs-collaboration.
- [2026-09-21-annotation-architecture-oss](../../../plite/research/2026-09-21-annotation-architecture-oss). Validates the Plite anchor, exact-view annotation index and paint ownership against ProseMirror decorations/bookmarks, Lexical MarkNode/comments, Tiptap Comments, Yjs relative positions and Automerge cursors, plus CodeMirror, Monaco and Quill, which have no home and go to editor-architecture.
- [2026-09-21-media-object-editable-content](../../../plite/research/2026-09-21-media-object-editable-content). Plite media object versus editable-caption semantics, backed by local Plate model probes and compared with ProseMirror atom/contentDOM, WordGard CaptionedFigure and Lexical DecoratorNode nested editors and named slots.
- [2026-09-24-export-architecture](../../../plite/research/2026-09-24-export-architecture). A first-principles review of Plate/Plite whole-document export ownership that compares source-level export contracts of prosemirror-model and prosemirror-markdown, Tiptap, Lexical, and BlockNote, CKEditor 5 and Quill (no homes of their own), so it compares editors.
- [2026-09-25-document-codec-architecture](../../../plite/research/2026-09-25-document-codec-architecture). Plate/Plite import-export codec API research (adopted). Its shard 004 and read log state source-level facts about ProseMirror (DOM parse vs parseSlice, separate Markdown parser and serializer), Tiptap (detached HTML/Markdown conversion, happy-dom server path), Lexical (conversion needs editor and global DOM context) and Portable Text (detached schema-aware conversion with unknown-node fallback), and compares them as cross-editor conversion architecture.
- [2026-10-02-agentic-e2e-testing](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-agentic-e2e-testing). Mostly Plate proof tooling: it judges tester-army e2e and the mobile agent tools against @platejs/test and the Playwright suites, then builds Plite's local Android Gboard and macOS Pinyin lanes, audits Plite's `__pliteBrowserHandle`, and drafts Plite IME bugs (plite); shard 005 and about 79 read-log rows rank Android cases from Slate's issue tracker and read Slate's android-input-manager, RestoreDOM, android-tests page and Playwright config (slate); shard 006 cites Lexical's CDP imeSetComposition e2e and ProseMirror's synthetic CompositionEvent tests as prior art (lexical, prosemirror) and compares how editors test IME, concluding none drives a real OS IME (editor-architecture).
- [2026-10-02-autocomplete-query-representation](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-autocomplete-query-representation). Compares where trigger autocomplete keeps its query across editors, with source-cited facts on Lexical, Slate, Tiptap, ProseKit, Milkdown and ProseMirror (prosemirror-view, inputrules, issue #903), plus Plate's own probes and the history of its 2024 combobox design, ending in a Plate autocomplete verdict.
- [2026-10-02-dnd-landing-policy](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-dnd-landing-policy). Plite transfer landing pipeline and Plate DnD feature rules mapped file by file, then compared with source-read drop-target, handle and container policy in ProseMirror, Tiptap, BlockNote, Lexical, ProseKit, Slate (zbeyens fork) and CKEditor 5.
- [2026-10-02-dnd-library-choice](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-dnd-library-choice). Keeps Plite's native drag driver and transfer owner and the copied DndKit over Pragmatic DnD, dnd-kit and React DnD, and a cross-editor table states drag implementation and test-limit facts for ProseMirror, Tiptap, Lexical, a Slate fork and BlockNote.

Other pages:

- [Editor Architecture Candidates for Plate](../editor-architecture/candidates.md). Ranked shortlist with per-editor takes on ProseMirror, Lexical, Tiptap, Portable Text and Slate, plus a Plite fact that plitejs/dom exposes DOMCoverage and DOMEditor to view adapters.
- [Cursor, Find, and Widget geometry architecture](../editor-architecture/cursor-find-and-widget-geometry.md). - [Decorations / annotations overlay corpus](../editor-architecture/decorations-annotations-overlay-corpus.md). Per-corpus overlay evidence for ProseMirror bookmarks and DecorationSet, Lexical marks, Tiptap node-range and focus, legacy Slate, and the Slate v2 (Plite) projection substrate.
- [Lexical mark/store/decorator split](../editor-architecture/lexical-mark-store-and-decorator-split.md). Lexical MarkNode/CommentStore/DecoratorNode and dirty-node evidence, plus a stated gap in current Slate v2 invalidation.

Node/text/mark/render DX corpus closure across ProseMirror NodeSpec/NodeView, Lexical node classes/NodeState and Tiptap extensions/React NodeViews; the Plite side is only a target recommendation.
- [Read/update runtime corpus ledger](../editor-architecture/read-update-runtime-corpus-ledger.md). A corpus ledger that records which Lexical, ProseMirror and Tiptap docs and source files were read, with the strongest read/update, transaction and extension evidence for each; it states no Plite facts.
- [Scroll, selection, and caret visibility runtime](../editor-architecture/scroll-selection-visibility-runtime.md). Scroll/caret-visibility mechanisms observed in ProseMirror, Lexical, CodeMirror, Tiptap, Milkdown and Obsidian; the Slate v2 part is a target only.
- [Yjs collaboration binding architecture](../editor-architecture/yjs-collaboration-bindings.md). Yjs binding architecture compiled from external slate-yjs, Lexical Yjs, y-prosemirror and the Slate v2 extension/collab substrate.
- [Slate v2 overlay architecture](../../systems/slate-v2-overlay-architecture.md). April 2026 Slate v2 overlay system map, whose Widget lane and Bookmark noun Plite later cut, contrasted with legacy Slate decorate and placed against ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap.
- [Slate v2 perfect plan steal reject defer map](../../systems/slate-v2-perfect-plan-steal-reject-defer-map.md). Cross-editor steal/reject/defer map for the Slate v2 (Plite) architecture, stating Lexical read/update and node-model, ProseMirror transaction/DOM and position, Tiptap extension/chain, and legacy Slate mutable-field and Transforms facts.
